investigation: PSI-21, ACME CLD Flame: methane and ethylene coflow flames diluted with nitrogen, on a 2.18 mm tube in a 25 mm air annulus
description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_cld_w0.md, section 7 (W0 with the exceptions stated in its section 8.3): loss of a dilute coflow flame by blow-off, and its radiometer excess. Time origin of loss: flame onset. The planned fuel-off (planned_fuel_off_from_onset, seconds since onset) is declared as the scheduled stop, which the typed edits of section 7.4 address. Derived case inputs (the most severe fraction and coflow of the schedule, the first constant-flow stage, the window and the stop) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.

features.name: x_fuel_final
features.description: lowest fuel fraction the script reaches (section 7.1)

features.name: v_coflow_final
features.description: highest coflow speed the script reaches (section 7.1)

features.name: window
features.description: planned fuel-off, seconds since flame onset (at_cutoff.planned_fuel_off_from_onset_s)

features.name: x_fuel_stage
features.description: x_fuel of the first constant-flow segment of the schedule

features.name: v_fuel_stage
features.description: v_fuel_m_s of the first constant-flow segment of the schedule

targets.name: loss
targets.description: the flame goes out while the fuel still flows, seconds since flame onset

targets.name: radiometer
targets.description: excess of the radiometer sum over its pre-ignition level in the first constant-flow stage (lane-local)
